resources: explicit v1 message config; no legacy ComputeBudget instructions
priorityFee: absolute lamports encoded in v1 configuration, never interpreted as micro-lamports per CU
wallet: actual solana:signTransaction feature advertises version1 on selected chain; verify all required signatures and unchanged message bytes
rpc: explicit trusted endpoint, exact genesis and BaseConfig, finalized/minContextSlot, bounded lossless integer JSON; successful actual v1 simulation required before launch
rpcAcceptance: PENDING only; finalized business nonce and cache or preserved confirmed history establish business result
retry: same business frame; blockhash may refresh only after actual nonce reconciliation; unknown submission never creates a new business operation
durability: atomic local CAS, durable attempt before send, fsynced terminal archive before pruning; no private key storage
localTests: do not certify a public RPC provider, wallet application or production deployment
